no_adcom_quote.quote: No advisory committee discussion or consultations external to the FDA were deemed necessary for this NDA.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for PIQRAY (alpelisib, NDA 212526). The FDA's Multidiscipline Review explicitly states that no advisory committee discussion or external consultations were deemed necessary for this NDA. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval. (A separate reference to the Molecular and Clinical Genetics Panel appears only in relation to the companion diagnostic device PMA, not the drug NDA.)
